subject: Mr. Irrelevant: The John Tuggle Story
query: is mr irrelevant a true story
title: Is Mr. Irrelevant a true story? Yes, John Tuggle's NFL story
answer: Yes. "Mr. Irrelevant: The John Tuggle Story" is based on the real John Tuggle, a Cal running back the New York Giants took with the very last pick of the 1983 NFL draft. He made the team as a special-teams standout, was diagnosed with cancer in 1984 and died in August 1986. The Paramount film opens in theaters Dec. 25, 2026.
body:
"Mr. Irrelevant" is the tongue-in-cheek nickname for the final player chosen in each year's NFL draft. In 1983 that was Tuggle, the 335th and last pick of a 12-round draft. Born in Honolulu in January 1961, he had played at the University of California, and few expected him to stick in the league.

He did. Tuggle made the Giants' roster as a rookie, spent most of the 1983 season covering kicks on special teams and was promoted to starting fullback late in the year. Pro Football Reference credits him with 16 games and five starts that season, 49 rushing yards and a touchdown, three catches and nine kickoff returns. His coach that year was Bill Parcells, in his first season leading the Giants. Tuggle was diagnosed with cancer in 1984 and died in August 1986, at 25, shortly before the season in which the Giants won their first Super Bowl.

The movie is directed by Jonathan Levine ("50/50") from a script by Nick Santora, with David Corenswet, the current Superman, as Tuggle and Michael Shannon as Parcells. Isabel May plays Tuggle's love interest, and the cast also includes David Krumholtz. Like most sports biopics, it compresses events and adds dramatized scenes, so treat dialogue and some characters as creative choices rather than a record. His story was told earlier in ESPN's short documentary "The Irrelevant Giant."

The film opens in U.S. theaters on Christmas Day 2026 from Paramount. Interest jumped in late November 2026, when Wikipedia views of Tuggle's page and searches about the film surged ahead of the holiday release.
in_the_news: "Mr. Irrelevant," starring David Corenswet as John Tuggle, opens in theaters Dec. 25, 2026, and searches about the real story spiked in late November.
